speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy with feeding difficulties and abdominal distension; to understand what is happening inside you, can you tell me if your vomiting is forceful and if it ever looks like it is coming back up out of your nose or mouth?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception. The clinical picture of an 8-month-old with feeding difficulties, abdominal distension, tenderness (crying on palpation), and vomiting is highly suggestive of intussusception. I am requesting an ultrasound of the abdomen to confirm the diagnosis immediately.
